subject: Pricing for pooled credits and incremental commit for new product line
messages:
From: Amir Khan <amir.khan@stratopay.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: purchasing@stratopay.com
Date: 2026-09-20T14:23:00-07:00
Subject: Pricing for additional product lines & teams

Hi Logan,

We're launching a 3rd product line focused on real-time fraud scoring and expect to put API calls through your Hosted API. We're also onboarding two additional engineering teams in Q4 who will share the same account. High level questions:

- Can we get per-token discounts at scale (examples for 5M / 20M / 100M tokens per month)?
- Do you support pooled credits across multiple teams under the same account?
- Is there a way to structure incremental commits for a new workload so we don't have to renegotiate the whole contract?

Rough usage estimate: 8–12M tokens/month for the fraud product in month 1, ramping to ~40–60M over 6 months. We'd like a simple example pricing sheet and an SOW we can review.

Can you send options and a proposed path to scale? If helpful, we can do a short call next week.

Thanks,
Amir Khan
Head of Platform
StratoPay

[Attachment: initial-requirements.pdf (pdf stub)]

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Amir Khan <amir.khan@stratopay.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai, evelyn.hart@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-22T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing for additional product lines & teams

Hi Amir — thanks for the context and usage estimate. Pushing this to the team; two feasible approaches below and I've attached a worked example (pricing-model.xlsx) and a starter SOW.

Option A — Incremental commit (recommended for predictable unit economics)
- Baseline commit: $25k/month (~5M tokens) at $0.005/token effective
- Incremental blocks: additional 5M blocks priced at step-down rates (example in spreadsheet)
- Credits can be pooled within the parent account and allocated to teams by tags

Option B — Pay-as-you-go with volume tiers
- Per-token billing with automatic tier discounts applied monthly (suitable if you want no commit)

Other notes:
- Unused committed credits can be rolled forward for up to 30 days (short-term rollover)
- Annual prepay eligible for an extra 10% discount on committed units

Would you prefer a short call to walk through the spreadsheet and confirm which pricing path fits your procurement constraints?

Best,
Logan Wright
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
loganw@redwood.ai

[Attachment: pricing-model.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-28T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing for additional product lines & teams

Logan — a few concrete suggestions to make the commercials smoother for StratoPay: 

1) Hybrid commit + pool: Baseline commit that covers the core fraud workload + a shared burst pool for other teams. Pool priced at a modest premium but provides cross-team absorbency.
2) Tier examples (month): 5M @ $0.0048/token, next 15M @ $0.0038/token, 100M+ negotiate 0.0028/token.
3) Minimum incremental commit: $15k/month (makes finance sign-off easier).
4) Add a 60-day pilot credit (1.5M tokens) for new teams to validate integration before committing.

I updated the spreadsheet with these numbers — attached. If legal needs to keep SOW language narrow, we can separate pool terms into an addendum so core SOW stays light.

-Marcus
Sr. Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

Thanks Logan — a couple follow-ups:

- Does the 30-day rollover apply to pooled credits or only to team-specific commits?

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-10-03T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing for additional product lines & teams

Amir — thanks, here are concrete numbers (summary; see attached pricing-model.xlsx for per-token math):

Scenario A — Monthly incremental commit (no annual prepay)
- 5M tokens/month: $24,000/month => effective $0.0048/token
- 20M tokens/month: $70,000/month => effective $0.0035/token
- 100M tokens/month: negotiated at $280,000/month => effective $0.0028/token

Scenario B — Annual prepay (12-month commit) 
- 5M equiv: 10% discount off monthly rates => $0.00432/token equivalent
- 20M equiv: 12% discount => $0.00308/token equivalent

Pooling & rollover
- Pooling: credits can be pooled at the account level and reallocated by team tags. Pool consumption is first-in/first-out across commits.
- Rollover: committed credits roll forward up to 30 days. Pool-level rollover also honored for the same 30-day window.

Pilot credits & conversion
- 60-day pilot credit: we can offer 1.5M tokens per new team (three teams eligible) for integration testing.
- Year-end conversion: unused committed credits cannot be converted to cash but we can offer a one-time conversion to a credit note that applies to the next quarter (subject to cap; proposed cap: 15% of annual commit).

Commercial mechanics
- Minimum incremental commit: $15k/month (recommended).
- Eligibility for additional 10% incentive: annual prepay covering at least 9 months.

Next steps: I can produce a term sheet + SOW and send to your procurement (I included a DocuSign link in the attachments). Please confirm whether StratoPay wants a pooled model or separate team buckets and whether procurement needs any further finance language.

Best,
Logan Wright
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
loganw@redwood.ai
